# ProxyTech - Software Engineering & Digital Scale
> High-performance software engineering, cloud systems, and digital product studio.

ProxyTech provides technology and digital services to businesses, high-growth startups, and enterprises.
Key competencies include:
- Native & Cross-Platform App Development (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter)
- High-Performance Web Development (Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind)
- UI/UX Design & Design Systems (Figma Tokens, WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Technical & Programmatic SEO (JSON-LD schemas, Core Web Vitals)
- Digital Marketing & Performance Engineering
- Software & SaaS Development (PostgreSQL, Supabase, Microservices, API Integrations)
